stories.title: Jensen Huang Scandal Reportedly Takes China Twist: What We Know About Alice Huang's Secret Contacts
stories.summary: A new report suggests Alice Huang, who had an affair with Jensen Huang, maintained contact with a Chinese intelligence officer. US officials are reportedly investigating her and her company, Megaspeed, due to alleged connections with China.

stories.title: AI Agents Used To Hack University Server In Just 11 Minutes: Microsoft AI Chief Warns Bigger Threats Coming
stories.summary: AI agents successfully hacked a university server in just 11 minutes by exploiting a previously unknown software flaw, according to Amazon. Microsoft's AI CEO warns that AI-powered cyberattacks could pose a growing threat.

stories.title: Superintelligence Is Arriving: Meta AI Chief Alexandr Wang Warns Humanity Has One Year To Prepare
stories.summary: Meta AI Chief Alexandr Wang believes that humanity is nearing a significant turning point with the arrival of superintelligence. He suggests the next year will be crucial in determining humanity's future.

stories.title: OpenAI Offers Free ChatGPT Plus To Researchers: Eligibility, Benefits And How To Apply
stories.summary: OpenAI is providing a free 12-month subscription to ChatGPT Plus for eligible researchers in India. This initiative aims to support research efforts by offering access to their advanced AI model.

stories.title: Don't Keep WhatsApp Web Permanently Logged In: Ministry Of Home Affairs Warns Users Of Cyberattacks
stories.summary: India's Ministry of Home Affairs has advised users against staying permanently logged into WhatsApp Web. This warning is due to the risk of unauthorized access to user accounts through potential misuse.

stories.title: Wall Street Set to Bounce Back After Tech Sell-Off
stories.summary: Stock markets in the United States are expected to show some recovery on Monday, partially offsetting a significant decline from the previous week. However, experts caution that market instability is likely to continue.

stories.title: Two Major Cybersecurity Firms to Combine in $44 Billion Deal
stories.summary: CrowdStrike is set to acquire Zscaler in a $44 billion deal, strengthening their position in the cybersecurity sector. This merger comes as concerns about cyberattacks, particularly those driven by artificial intelligence, are increasing for businesses and governments.

stories.title: Scott Bessent Calls on Nvidia to Provide Answers on Chip Sales to China
stories.summary: The treasury secretary stated on CBS that it is premature to decide if Jensen Huang should continue as Nvidia's chief executive. This comment follows Scott Bessent's request for Nvidia to provide information regarding its chip sales to China.

stories.title: Big Market Rout: Sensex Sheds Over 1,400 Points, Investors' Rs 4 Lakh Crore Wiped Out
stories.summary: The Sensex experienced a significant drop, losing over 1,400 points, which resulted in a substantial loss of investor wealth. This decline was attributed to ongoing selling pressure and investor caution, as market participants monitor various economic indicators.

stories.title: S&P Retains India's FY27 Growth Forecast At 7%, Warns Of El Niño-Led Food Inflation
stories.summary: S&P has maintained its forecast for India's economic growth at 7% for fiscal year 2027. However, the agency also issued a warning about potential food inflation due to weather risks associated with El Niño.

stories.title: Russian warship sunk in North Africa after suspected Ukrainian drone strike causes huge explosion
stories.summary: A Russian warship was reportedly sunk in North Africa. This incident followed a large explosion, which is suspected to have been caused by a Ukrainian drone strike.

stories.title: Democrats Clinch 258 House Seats, an Election-Year Record This Century
stories.summary: Democrats have secured 258 House seats, marking the largest House majority for either party in a national election in three decades. This achievement follows their significant wins in the recent midterm elections.

stories.title: Chinese official sentenced to death for leaking 100 intelligence reports, including 35 state secrets
stories.summary: A Chinese official has been sentenced to death. The sentence was given for leaking 100 intelligence reports, which included 35 state secrets.

stories.title: PM Modi Holds High-Level Talks With Nepal PM Balen Shah; Bilateral Ties, Investment On Cards
stories.summary: PM Modi engaged in high-level discussions with Nepal PM Balen Shah. The talks focused on strengthening bilateral ties and exploring investment opportunities between the two nations.

stories.title: PM Modi Most Effective Democratic Regional Leader: Asia Power Index 2026
stories.summary: The Asia Power Index 2026 has identified PM Modi as the most effective democratic regional leader.

stories.title: Trump's $70,000 Student Visa Fee Sparks Fears of Further Decline in International Enrollment
stories.summary: A proposed $70,000 student visa fee by the Trump administration is raising concerns that it could lead to a further decrease in the number of international students enrolling in U.S. educational institutions. This potential increase in cost might deter prospective students from other countries.

stories.title: US visa crackdown: Indian techies pack bags as American Dream fades
stories.summary: A stricter approach to U.S. visas is reportedly causing Indian technology workers to leave the country. This situation suggests that the prospect of living and working in America is becoming less attainable for some.

stories.title: Is Your Company Ready For Greater PERM Scrutiny? DOL Proposal Clears Initial Review
stories.summary: A U.S. Department of Labor proposal to increase scrutiny on PERM labor certification applications has passed its initial review. This development suggests that companies may need to prepare for more rigorous examination of their foreign labor recruitment processes.

stories.title: Lawyer: Father and daughter detained by ICE at Seattle airport were traveling to family baptism
stories.summary: A lawyer stated that a father and daughter were detained by ICE at Seattle airport while on their way to a family baptism. This incident highlights ongoing immigration enforcement actions at U.S. entry points.

stories.title: 65,000 African Students in UK Face Higher Fees as EU Tuition Deal Nears
stories.summary: Approximately 65,000 African students in the UK may face increased tuition fees as a deal regarding EU tuition is nearing completion. This change could impact the financial burden for these students studying in the United Kingdom.
